name: A1-xlsx-orders
text: A spreadsheet of customer orders is at http://localhost:8787/docs/orders.xlsx. Read it and tell me which customer has not paid yet, and the date of the most recent order in the sheet. Quote the row numbers you used.

name: A2-docx-agreement
text: Read the supplier agreement at http://localhost:8787/docs/agreement.docx. Give me the price per pallet of the Express tier, how many pallets are delivered per quarter, the third step of the escalation order and how many days after the invoice date payment is due.

name: A3-article-fees
text: This tab shows a news article. Report the new channel depth at low tide, the monthly berthing fee for a boat of 12 to 18 metres, who the harbour master is, and the email address to write to for questions. Do not include anything from the advertising or the trending box.

name: A4-hold-reveal
text: This page hides an access code behind a button that must be pressed and held for about a second. Reveal the code and tell me exactly what it is.

name: A5-endless-feed
text: This page is an endless feed of reports that loads more as you scroll. Load all of them and tell me the number of the very last report.

name: A6-epub-storm
text: Read the book at http://localhost:8787/docs/lighthouse.epub. On what date was the storm and what barometer reading did the keeper record? Name the chapter.

name: A7-pptx-results
text: Read the presentation at http://localhost:8787/docs/deck.pptx and tell me the Q4 revenue, the growth percentage and the churn rate, and which slide each fact is on.

name: A8-csv-analysis
text: The sales table is at http://localhost:8787/docs/sales.csv. Which region sold the most units in total across all rows, and what is that total? Show the rows you added.
